subject: 浚县碧霞宫 · 正殿前部拜殿立面
author: Windmemories
source_note: Windmemories于2024年12月1日实拍，选中轴正殿的前部拜殿立面。以照片可见屋面、柱网与门窗为依据，去掉树木、供具、遮阳伞和游客；台缘与侧阶仅概括露出部分，不重建未见后殿屋面及被供具挡住的御路雕刻。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line architectural illustration for 访古. Image1 is ONLY line-style master: delicate confident sparse BLACK ink contours, open blank planes, restrained detail. Image2 is actual subject GEOMETRY: the main hall and attached front worship hall of Bixia Palace (碧霞宫正殿与拜殿), Fuqiu Mountain, Jun/Xun County, Henan. Draw ONLY the central building's photographed frontal facade and roof, not its side halls. Preserve the exact broad rolled roof of the front worship hall, upturned tips, visible FIVE-bay facade with the original column spacing, open central entrance, paired timber door panels and carved outer window panels, bracket-and-carved-lintel band. Roof is the photographed curved rolled crest: no tall straight main ridge or invented ridge ornaments. Do NOT reconstruct the unseen rear hall roof. Facade-level nearly straight-on view, correct verticals. Remove trees, lanterns, tourists, parasol, incense burners, stone steles, fences, offerings and all modern clutter. Retain only visible terrace edge and simple side stair outlines, omit obstructed center terrace decoration rather than inventing a dragon ramp. Carvings selective: a few structural ornamental outlines, no lettering or dense roof tiles. Landscape1536x1024, entire depicted roof and facade fit with about9% side margins, balanced whitespace. BLACK fine neutral ink lines on perfectly flat OPAQUE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas. All empty spaces inside and outside building are uniformly pure white; doors/windows outlined without solid black fills. Output RGB or RGBA with alpha255 everywhere, no transparency. No grey shading, gradients, paper texture, grain, color, halos, ground shadow, checkerboard, lettering, watermark or frame. This is an artistic front elevation of the visible hall, not an archaeological reconstruction.

site_recommendation.name: 浚县碧霞宫
site_recommendation.sub: 正殿前部 · 拜殿立面
site_recommendation.era: 明 · 嘉靖二十一年始建，后世续修
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1542为资料记载的正殿始建纪年，明清历次重修形成现貌；图版仅为前部拜殿，不把未见的后殿屋面纳入绘制。
site_recommendation.place: 河南 · 鹤壁 · 浚县浮丘山
site_recommendation.lede: 卷棚屋面舒展在木雕和彩绘之上，红色门柱围住深暗的殿门。浮丘山上的碧霞宫，以拜殿与正殿相连的布局保存了明清民间宫观的繁密工艺。
facts: 营建与续修 资料将正殿始建记为明嘉靖二十一年（1542），此后明清多次修缮扩建；现貌不等于全部构件均为初建原件。
殿堂组合 前部卷棚歇山拜殿与后部悬山正殿相连，前檐木雕、透雕窗和彩绘构成丰富的立面。
取景说明 依2024年正面实拍绘前部拜殿，省略邻殿、树木、供具及文字；台缘与侧阶作概括，不复原被遮挡的中部御路雕刻。

checks: 五开间、六根主要前柱、卷棚屋面、外侧透雕窗与三处门洞核对。
仅画前部拜殿，台缘和侧阶概括，不复原未见后屋面或中部御路雕刻。
纯白底细黑线，无供具、游客、文字或灰面。
